verses: Mein qasam khata hun qayamat kay din ki
Aur qasam khata hun uss nafs ki jo malamat kerney wala ho
Kiya insan yeh khayal kerta hai kay hum uss ki hadiyan jama keren gay hi nahi
Haan zaroor keren gay hum to qadir hain kay uss ki por por tak durust ker den
Balkay)yeh insan to chahata hai kay aagay aagay farmaniyan kerta jaye
Poochata hai kay qayamat ka din kab aaye ga
Pus jiss waqt kay nigah pathra jaye gi
Aur chand bey noor ho jaye ga
Aur sooraj aur chand jama kerdiye jayen gay
Uss din insan kahey ga kay aaj bhagney ki jagah kahan hai?
Nahi nahi koi panah gaah nahi
Aaj to teray perwerdigar ki taraf hi qarar gaah hai
Aaj insan ko uss kay aagay bhejay huye aur peechay choray huye say aagah kiya jaye ga
Balkay)yeh insan khud apney upper aap hujjat hai
Agar cheh kitnay hi bahaney paish keray
(aey nabi) aap Quran ko jaldi (yaad kerney) kay liye apni zaban ko harkat na den
Uss ka jama kerna aur (aap ki zaban say) parhna humaray zimmay hai
Hum jab ussay parh len to aap uss kay parhney ki pairwee keren
Phir uss ka wazeh ker dena humaray zimmay hai
Nahi nahi tum jaldi milney wali (duniya) ki mohabbat rakhtay ho
Aur aakhirat ko chor bethay ho
Uss roz boht say chehray tar-o-taza aur ba-ronaq hun gay
Apney rab ki taraf dekhtay hun gay
Aur kitnay chehray uss din (bad ronaq aur) udas hun gay
Samajhtay hun gay kay unn kay sath kamar tor denay wala moamla kiya jaye ga
Nahi nahi jab rooh hansli tak phonchay gi
Aur kaha jaye ga kay koi jhaar phoonk kerney wala hai?
Aur jaan liya uss ney kay yeh waqt judaee hai
Aur pindli say pindli lipat jaye gi
Aaj teray perwerdigar ki taraf chalna hai
Uss ney na to tasdeeq ki na namaz ada ki
Balkay)yeh jhutlaya aur roo-gardani ki
Phir apney ghar walon kay pass itrata hua gaya
Afsos hai tujh per hasrat hai tujh per
Waaye hai aur kharabi hai teray liye
Kiya insan yeh samjhta hai kay ussay beykaar chor diya jaye ga
Kiya woh aik gaarhay pani ka katra na tha jo tapkaya gaya tha?
Phir woh lahoo ka lothra hogaya phir Allah ney ussay peda kiya aur durust bana diya
Phir uss say joray yani nurr o madah banaye
Kiya (Allah Taalaa) uss (amar) per qadir nahi kay murday ko zindah kerdey
